findings.title: Missing segment relation now raises OO002 on the reference path
findings.statement: On commit 6cd955, the independent probe ran 0003 only against an empty database, a 0000-only database, a v1 database whose apply_receipts table was dropped, and a v1 database whose apply_receipts_segment_check was dropped. Each returned SQLSTATE OO002 and the message target-fence-receipts/1 segment relation is absent, with zero target-fence-receipts/3 rows. The same probe ran frozen 0002 and then 0003 on the 0000-only database and recorded 42P01 relation "_oo.apply_receipts" does not exist. That dead path is RED and is not a route. 0002 bytes are unchanged.

findings.title: Closed segment rule stays the 0002 bytes
findings.statement: Function, history DO, and CHECK slices of 0003 equal 0002. Fresh calls reject three NULL mixtures with 23514 before a stale legal call can report OO013. Absent-legal, present-legal, and 8192 insert. 8193 and a direct unknown row reject 23514. Illegal history raises OO021 and leaves receipts and the v1 CHECK unchanged. The 17/163 grid is a static Rust count labeled static_grid_is_not_a_new_pg_180_run. The 320-case matrix was not rerun.

findings.statement: The owner-and-writer insert exercised here is the illegal NULL mixture. The CHECK rejects it with 23514 and the row is absent after rollback. This probe does not close a lawful owner insert. F2 stays open.
